findings.title: Raw legacy Binding is falsely labelled full permission and without expiry
findings.origin: Pre-existing misleading display retained in the changed component; explicitly within the requested truthful legacy raw Binding acceptance scope.
findings.trigger: List any pre-v12 raw Binding with kind=legacy, scopes=['context:read'], grants=null; or a raw legacy Binding whose replacement retirement supplies a finite expires_at.
findings.observed: The type row unconditionally says 旧方式创建（全部权限、无有效期） for every legacy kind. Row/parser discard the real scopes DTO. A finite expiry can be shown in the next row while the type still says no expiry. The component test explicitly preserves that incorrect phrase.

source_proof.scope: Read-only existing list DTO excerpt, not execution evidence
source_proof.meaning: kind=legacy only means the v12 authorization row is absent; the list returns b.scopes and an expiry derived from authorization expiry or retirement. It does not assert that every raw Binding holds all permissions or remains valid indefinitely.

findings.impact: The Owner receives incorrect permission and lifetime information at the exact point where old connections are assessed and rotated. This defeats the accepted separation of range, operation and legacy coverage; it does not itself prove a backend authorization bypass.
required_fix: Render the creation type as 旧方式创建 without inferring scope or lifetime from kind.

Preserve and validate actual scopes from the list DTO and display only their true technical operation meaning; when no authoritative resource grant/coverage is supplied, mark resource coverage as unavailable or requiring confirmation rather than inventing all contexts/full rights.
Display actual expiry/retirement separately; distinguish an absent expiry value from verified indefinite validity.
Preserve empty explicit rotation selection for legacy grants=null and require the existing real Native two-step confirmation for any replacement or wider selection.
minimum_validation: Raw legacy fixture with only context:read: display read scope, no write/full/all-context claim, unknown resource coverage qualified.
Raw legacy fixture with finite retirement and replaced_by: show the actual retirement time with no no-expiry claim.
Missing or malformed scopes: fail closed or clearly show unknown; do not infer full permission. Keep the existing no implicit-upgrade/no automatic-rotation assertions.
Replace the test assertion that expects the false full/no-expiry label, rerun the targeted headless component tests, then issue a new exact UI manifest for independent re-review.

reviewed_behavior.assessment: Static implementation separates all-context macro from operation presets. Specified selection begins empty; switching ranges clears exact choices. Reader/developer/full intersect actual row capabilities, and OAuth selections also intersect requested scopes. Existing preset application changes only selected resources.

Full helper/controls/tests include profile-only, one named project canonical row, and one named test-context row; selected transport preserves exact kind/id/environment. Only contexts:* represents existing plus future owned resources. Shared/invited resources are stated to require separate selection. Actual backend metadata and future-resource enforcement remain combined gates.

Native management separates range and operations, labels legacy project macro as own project canonical records, and warns that old coverage omits project-use contexts. Reads do not authorize or rotate. Wider authorization requires current client request and Owner confirmation. Actual UI-M01 legacy raw headless mislabel remains.

sources_v1 transport submits real source IDs/base versions/action caps and exact overrides with existing IDs/base versions; it does not resubmit derived grants as independent direct selections. Local tests cover removal of new policy preserving legacy read, precise-deny union and malformed source DTO refusal. Persisted server reductions/limits are unqualified until combined review and runtime tests.

Source-aware rotation sends no derived direct selections, binds current source/override versions, requires source_snapshot matching binding version, and preserves limits for Native confirmation. New default macro is not silently copied to old grants=null rotation. Secret issuance remains a separate real issue/confirm step; no production issuance was performed.

Actual confirmation page uses the service-issued token/digest and requires complete matching coverage before approval; actual coverage, missing actions and preserved restrictions are displayed. Missing/stale coverage prevents grant invocation. Client-side validation is supporting UI behavior, not proof of backend snapshot authenticity or atomicity.

reviewed_behavior.area: Record, Event, history and eight views
reviewed_behavior.assessment: Immediate authoritative label is a qualified typed-Record badge with authoritative=true, CURRENT, recognized record type and non-candidate/non-legacy semantics. Event authority remains separate. History/candidates are not promoted. VIEW_KEYS remains eight entries; no ninth authorization/currentness view is introduced. Existing namespace, selected context and read fences remain in source. No automatic real-time push promise is added.
